description:
Perform a Recency, Frequency, Monetary (RFM) analysis on the Chinook customer database. 

1. Connect to the Chinook SQLite database at /home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook.db.
2. Create a new table or view named 'customer_rfm' to store the analysis.
3. Populate it with one row per customer: CustomerId, Recency (days since last purchase relative to 2014-01-01), Frequency (total invoice count), Monetary (total spend), and Segment.
4. Apply these segmentation rules in order:
   - VIP: Monetary > $40.00
   - Loyal: Frequency >= 5 (if not VIP)
   - Churn Risk: Recency > 365 days (if not VIP or Loyal)
   - Standard: All others
5. Export the results to /home/ga/Documents/exports/rfm_segments.csv (must include headers).
6. Save your SQL script to /home/ga/Documents/scripts/rfm_analysis.sql.
